method: Policies from the multiplayer training archive and single-head acquisition and trade policies seed three rounds of Collector-only evolutionary search. Separate fixed seed domains supply search, selection and final verification. Each start is played from all three seats and all policies use the same boards for a comparison. One specialist locks before the final matchups. Only a paired 95% interval strictly above zero against original v4 qualifies it for optional use at two-Collector tables.
